messages:
Anna: Quick sync request — can we schedule a 45min meeting next week to do an RBAC/access review + threat-modeling pre-audit? Need to lock down owner actions before the audit kickoff.
Mike: +1, sounds good. What days work for folks? :calendar:
Sara: Tue/Thu mornings generally best for me. Prefer 09:30-11:00 PT.
Jamal: I can do Tue afternoon or Wed morning. If we need the compliance folks, wed 10:00 PT is easiest.
Anna: Okay trying to find overlap. Proposed agenda (draft):
```
1) 10m - Context + audit scope recap (Jamal)
2) 15m - RBAC changes review (Anna/Mike)
3) 10m - Threat model updates for new private deployment flow (Sara)
4) 5m - Action items & owners
5) 5m - Scheduling follow-ups / access recert windows
```
Mike: Can we add a quick checklist item: confirm service accounts with wide permissions and any cross-account roles? Might take another 5m.
Anna: Good call — I'll expand item 2 to 20m and trim follow-ups.
ops-bot: Proposed meeting times added to thread poll: Tue 10:00 PT, Tue 16:00 PT, Wed 10:00 PT. Vote with reactions.
Sara: Voted :thumbsup: for Wed 10:00 PT.
Mike: Reacted :thumbsup: for Tue 10:00 PT — i'm flexible but prefer earlier.
Jamal: Wed 10:00 PT works for me too. If majority picks Wed we should confirm with Legal for 10m pre-read window.
Anna: Looks like Wed 10:00 PT is the winner (2 votes + me). I'll send calendar invite and include pre-reads.
Anna: Pre-reads I'll attach: export of current RBAC policy diff (branch: infra/rbac-audit), short threat-model doc, and the access matrix CSV. Please review before meeting.
Mike: Quick note: the RBAC diff includes a templatized change to service-role mapping. If you want to test locally:
```
# to view diff
git fetch origin infra/rbac-audit
git --no-pager diff origin/main..origin/infra/rbac-audit -- rbacs/
```
Sara: I'll run the threat model tool against the new flow and post high-level notes by EOD Monday.
Jamal: I'll coordinate Legal for the compliance checklist, will post any blockers.
Anna: Thanks. Action owners so far: Anna = send invite + attach pre-reads; Mike = prepare RBAC diff walkthrough; Sara = threat-model notes; Jamal = legal/compliance checklist.
Mike: One more ask — can we get oncall presence? Just in case we need to map incidents to access controls. @ops-bot can we flag oncall?
ops-bot: Oncall engineer (Lina) notified via DM.
Anna: Great. If anyone has other agenda items add them as replies here. Otherwise I'll send invite for Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT and mark it 45min. :calendar: :eyes:
